objective.name: sandbox.inspect.local.trace
objective.description: Wrapper-backed capacity that inspects local user traces through the public trace.inspect capability.

#root.role: Query one local trace.inspect events view filtered to user traces and summarize the first matching event.

effects.local_trace_projection: The wrapper emits one outbound trace.inspect request to its own context and summarizes the returned trace events.

transformation_contract.morphing: A wrapper request becomes one local trace inspection summary over user traces selected by reason_code and optionally narrowed to a recent time window.
invariants: The wrapper does not access local trace files directly.
The wrapper always uses trace.inspect for local trace observation.
The payload summarizes only the first matching event plus aggregate count.
success: On success, sandbox.inspect.local.trace returns whether a matching local user trace was found and the first matching event fields.
An empty result is a valid successful outcome expressed through found=false and event_count=0.
failure: The capability fails if the outbound trace.inspect request cannot complete.
The capability does not mask errors returned by trace.inspect.
notes: When from_ts_ns and to_ts_ns are provided, they are forwarded as trace.inspect time_range to avoid scanning unrelated older trace history.
This capacity is used as the remote-side wrapper observer behind sandbox.inspect.remote.trace in N7 system tests.
